name: askama-adjacent-groups
instr:
Add adjacent-group metadata to Askama's template loops in `/app` for run headers and sizes without sorting input. Don't add crates.

Accept `{% for target in iterable by key %}` and `{% for target in iterable if condition by key %}`, with one or more comma-separated key expressions after `by`. Keys bind targets by reference, even for destructured targets and owned items. Reject empty keys and trailing commas; `by` comes after `if`, when present. Keys may be arithmetic expressions or borrowed fields, including `String` fields; neither items nor keys need `Clone`.

Group filtered items without reordering. At zero-based depth `d`, runs are maximal adjacent items equal under `PartialEq` on all keys through `d`. Inner run numbers restart within each parent run. Equal keys separated by a different prefix start different runs. `loop.group(d)` accepts an in-range nonnegative integer literal depth and exposes `index0`, `index`, `position0`, `position`, `first`, `last`, `length`. These deepest-level aliases work in output, conditions and local bindings:

- `loop.group_index0` and `loop.group_index`: zero- and one-based run numbers.
- `loop.group_position0` and `loop.group_position`: zero- and one-based item positions within its run.
- `loop.group_first` and `loop.group_last`: whether the item is first or last in its run.
- `loop.group_length`: accepted-item count within its run.

For `[2, 2, 7, 2]` grouped by the item, run lengths are `[2, 1, 1]`. `loop.index0`, `loop.index`, `loop.fir
